decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of planning permission P/2025/2241 approved 24/09/2025.

Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 92 (1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Fire safety statement, 100 REV P5, design & access statement, planning & heritage statement

Received: 21/07/2025

101 REV P10

Received: 11/09/2025

104 REV P8, 105 REV P1

Received: 18/09/2025

Energy and sustainability assessment 

Received: 05/12/2025) 

therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans. 

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area
Condition : 4 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy.

Reason: In order to ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.
Condition : 5 - The development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less.

Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources.
Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of any part of the development the hard and soft landscaping shall be carried out in full in accordance with the approved details 105 REV P1 Received: 18/09/2025 and maintained in accordance with such thereafter. 

Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area and to promote biodiversity
Condition : 7 - The cycle parking shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details 101 REV P10 Received: 11/09/2025 and maintained in accordance with such thereafter. 
The approved facilities shall be fully implemented prior to occupation and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Reason: To support sustainable transport objectives
Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings/enclosures within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out, other than as shown in the approved drawings, and no additional floor space shall be formed within the building(s) hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division (new mezzanine level) without prior written approval of the local planning authority.

Reason:  To protect neighbours' living conditions and the character and appearance of the conservation area and to prevent over-intensive use of the site. 
Condition : 9 - The single storey outbuildings on site shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the houses at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow an amended energy statement of planning permission P/2025/2241 approved 24/09/2025 for the erection of a single storey and part two storey rear extensions, part front extension, two rear dormer extensions with four front roof windows and raising the existing roof ridge. Changing all the existing windows to allow the conversion of the existing residential unit into two residential units.
